senses.meaning: Thuộc về chương trình giảng dạy
examples: Extracurricular activities are an important part of school life.
The school made several curricular changes this year.
Curricular reform has been a key priority for the education ministry.

senses.meaning: Mang tính giáo huấn, dùng để giảng dạy; (tiêu cực) thuyết giảng quá mức
examples: The fable has a didactic purpose — teaching children about honesty.
His teaching style was considered overly didactic and boring.
The novel is intentionally didactic, promoting clear moral values.

note: Thường mang hàm ý tiêu cực khi dùng để mô tả người hoặc văn bản — giảng đạo một cách nhàm chán, áp đặt.

examples: University tuition fees have risen sharply over the past decade.
She couldn't afford the tuition and had to drop out.
The scholarship covered full tuition and living expenses.

senses.meaning: Sự dạy học, kèm cặp riêng
examples: He received private tuition in mathematics every week.
The center offers tuition in English for foreign students.
One-to-one tuition can be very effective for struggling learners.

note: Tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng 'tuition' để chỉ học phí; tiếng Anh Anh có thể dùng cho cả hai nghĩa.

examples: The school redesigned its curriculum to include more STEM subjects.
Reading and writing are core parts of the primary school curriculum.
He argued that history should be more prominent in the national curriculum.

senses.meaning: Đọc thuộc lòng trước đám đông; kể lại, liệt kê
examples: She stood up and recited the poem from memory.
Students were asked to recite the multiplication tables.
He recited a long list of complaints to the manager.

senses.meaning: Học nhồi nhét (trước kỳ thi); nhồi đầy vào chỗ chật hẹp
examples: He spent the whole night cramming for the final exam.
You can't cram a year's worth of knowledge into one study session.
She crammed her suitcase with clothes for the two-week trip.

note: 'Cram for an exam' = ôn thi gấp trong thời gian ngắn. Thường hiệu quả ngắn hạn nhưng không giúp ghi nhớ lâu dài.

senses.meaning: Sự dạy dỗ, chỉ bảo của người có thẩm quyền; sự giám hộ
examples: She developed her skills under the tutelage of a renowned chef.
The young artist flourished under the tutelage of her mentor.
Under his tutelage, the team won three consecutive championships.

note: Formal/literary. Thường dùng trong cụm 'under the tutelage of' = dưới sự chỉ dạy của.
